```{python}
import re

```
```{python}
# Stopwords (from Day 18)

             "she", "he", "be", "that", "you", "not", "had", "as", "his", "for",

```
```{python}
with open("../../homework/hw5/hw5_raw.txt", "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    fin_lines = f.readlines()
fin_text = "".join(fin_lines)
```
```{python}
verses = re.split(r'\s*\[.*?\]\s*', fin_text)
verses = verses[1:]
```
```{python}
rows = []
verses_num = 0

for verse in verses:
    verses_num += 1
    lines = re.split(r"[\n]+", verse.lower())   # split on \W AND on _
    lines = [l for l in lines if l != ""]
    for l in lines:
        rows.append({"line": l, "verses": verses_num})

fin_df = pd.DataFrame(rows)
```
```{python}
# 4. Save it for next time
fin_df.to_csv("hw5_deweese_abagail.csv", index=False, encoding="utf-8-sig")
```
